source_scope.authoritative_document: DIM语兴好物（y shopping）电商数据表.md
source_scope.scope_rule: This slice covers candidate assets without an authoritative ODS domain that have a same-name CREATE in the DIM document. It preserves source meaning through governed versions or projections, while rejecting wrong-layer raw connectors and preventing dimensions from becoming business or security authority.

verification_policy.specified_definition: Same-name CREATE plus explicit canonical entity split, source mapping, grain, history, security boundary, authority and defect correction.
verification_policy.verified_definition: Non-empty production source-to-canonical reconciliation with stable source keys, effective-time version selection, restricted-field controls, independent row/content checks and zero unexplained differences.

reference_taxonomy_version.grain: one tenant, namespace, reference value and immutable effective-time version
history_rules: namespace prevents the source table and field name from becoming a global business key
effective_from and effective_to are non-overlapping and evaluated at the fact event time
code and description types are explicit and locale-aware
owner, approval, provenance and deprecation are retained
unknown and deleted values remain auditable rather than being silently relabelled
a reference label never grants entitlement or changes source-domain state
reference_taxonomy_version.security: Public labels may be projected broadly; ownership, moderation and operational metadata remain least-privilege.
reference_taxonomy_version.authority: The owning domain approves meanings; the dimension only versions and resolves them.

catalog_product_version.grain: one tenant, canonical style or variant and immutable catalog version
history_rules: source SPU maps to ProductStyle and source SKU maps to ProductVariant
category brand fit and attribute values bind to their effective versions
money uses integer minor units and ISO currency
article numbers and barcodes are typed source mappings rather than alternate primary keys
JSON attributes are normalized into versioned typed values
catalog status does not imply listing saleability, price availability or inventory
catalog_product_version.security: Media and descriptive attributes are publishable only through listing policy; source lineage remains internal.
catalog_product_version.authority: Catalog owns style and variant identity; Listing, Pricing and Inventory retain their own authority.

coupon_definition_version.grain: one tenant, coupon template or campaign and immutable approved version
history_rules: template and campaign are separate entities with stable source mappings
benefit money uses integer minor units and ISO currency
threshold is a typed eligibility rule rather than an unqualified number
validity uses declared timezone and half-open boundaries
creator is a Principal reference and display name is not identity
configuration never proves issuance entitlement redemption or settlement
coupon_definition_version.security: Creator contact and internal remarks are restricted; no credential or payment instrument is copied.
coupon_definition_version.authority: Promotion owns approved definitions and Coupon Entitlement owns user effects.

restricted_principal_projection.grain: one tenant, canonical Principal and purpose-limited effective profile version
history_rules: source user employee and operator identifiers map through SourceIdentity
display profile, consent, verification, membership and workforce assignment are separate versioned concepts
age is not reconstructed from a national identifier in the general dimension
address, receiver, contact, device and payment-handle data remain purpose-bound restricted projections
credentials, password material and raw legal identifiers are excluded
staff KOL student VIP and test flags never create authorization by themselves
restricted_principal_projection.security: PII is tokenized or vaulted, access is purpose-bound and audited, and analytics receives minimized or pseudonymous attributes.
restricted_principal_projection.authority: Identity resolves Principals; Membership, Workforce, Verification and Authorization own their effects.

policy_rule_version.grain: one tenant, policy key and immutable approved effective version
history_rules: rule input, expected parameters and outputs use a typed schema
owner reviewer approval and change reason are mandatory
effective windows are non-overlapping and timezone explicit
manual uploads retain file digest and source-row lineage
rollback points to an earlier immutable version
configuration and allowlist membership never prove an enforced decision
policy_rule_version.security: Policy internals and allowlists are restricted; secrets and credentials are external vault references only.
policy_rule_version.authority: Governance versions policy; the owning operational domain records enforcement decisions and effects.

ai_workflow_projection.grain: one tenant and immutable AI account, application or workflow version; realtime cache rows are disposable projections
history_rules: account identity, application and workflow are separate entities
creator joins use canonical Principal mappings rather than mutable names
workflow_id binds to an immutable workflow version
offline snapshots and realtime Redis cache projections expose the same stable source identity
cache keys are namespaced by tenant and source system
deletion disablement and cache expiry do not erase historical workflow runs
ai_workflow_projection.security: Passwords, salts, API keys and Redis credentials are excluded and managed in an external secret store; email and login IP are restricted.
ai_workflow_projection.authority: Identity owns account resolution and AI Operations owns application/workflow lifecycle; Redis projections are never authoritative.

token_marketplace_projection.grain: one tenant and immutable user mapping, model/configuration version or signed Skill package version
history_rules: username is display data and Principal mapping uses stable source identity
model capability, provider route and pricing are independently versioned
price and quota use integer units with ISO currency where monetary
Skill content is a signed digest-addressed package with publisher and provenance
installation access is represented by a separate entitlement
definitions do not debit quota, settle top-ups or create access
token_marketplace_projection.security: Passwords, API keys and provider secrets are external vault references; user contact and package internals are least-privilege.
token_marketplace_projection.authority: Token Platform owns usage/quota/model access, Marketplace owns packages and entitlements, Payment owns settlement.

warehouse_reference.grain: one tenant, canonical warehouse and effective source mapping version
history_rules: the misspelled warhouse name is retained only as a source alias
warehouse code and source id are mappings rather than universal identifiers
address and contact are purpose-bound attributes
status changes are versioned and do not rewrite history
location and zone hierarchy are separate canonical entities
warehouse existence never proves inventory quantity or availability
warehouse_reference.security: Operational contacts and precise addresses are restricted to fulfillment purposes.
warehouse_reference.authority: Warehouse Network owns nodes and mappings; Inventory owns quantities and Fulfillment owns routing effects.

quality_ai_reference.grain: one tenant, quality reason, model, identification part or result enum and immutable version
history_rules: model version includes artifact digest, provider and reproducible configuration
product and rule configuration bind to approved policy versions
identification parts and enums are typed reference versions
AI output and human ground truth remain distinct evidence
thresholds are effective policy versions rather than hard-coded truth
reference rows never directly block a listing, refund or warehouse operation
quality_ai_reference.security: Model artifacts, prompts and review evidence are access-controlled; no raw customer content is copied into reference dimensions.
quality_ai_reference.authority: AI Operations owns attempts/models, Quality owns accepted review and owning domains apply business effects.

merchant_projection.grain: one tenant and one canonical merchant account, shop, legal entity, operator assignment or source mapping version
history_rules: merchant account, shop and legal entity are separate stable identities
operator identity uses Principal assignment with effective dates
legal registration and settlement references are purpose-bound subrecords
bank accounts are tokenized payment-instrument references rather than copied strings
status and audit histories remain immutable
merchant projection does not grant listing, settlement, deposit or withdrawal effects
merchant_projection.security: Legal identifiers, bank data, phones, emails and addresses are vaulted or tokenized and available only to approved purposes.
merchant_projection.authority: Merchant owns onboarding and identity; Payment/Ledger owns settlement and Catalog/Listing owns sellable offers.

wrong_layer_raw_source.grain: one source topic, partition, offset and immutable raw change envelope
history_rules: the ODS connector remains a raw ingestion concern and is rejected as DIM authority
source schema version and payload digest are retained
tenant and source identity are validated before projection
offsets and event time support deterministic replay
poison messages quarantine without disappearing
only governed canonical projections may serve dimensions
wrong_layer_raw_source.security: Raw payload access is restricted and connector credentials are external secrets.
wrong_layer_raw_source.authority: ODS records source evidence only; it cannot define AI account, application or policy semantics.
